expected.subject: Priya, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Priya,

I'm with Legora, the legal AI platform for Employment used by partners at Goodwin and White & Case.

You're probably still spending too much time managing the manual review of employment contracts, settlement agreements, and restrictive covenants across matters.

I'd love to share the use cases that other attorneys are using heavily for similar work in your practice area and hear your thoughts.

Would you be interested in joining one of our live demo webinars?

William
Legora

notes: Helmsley & Co Senior Associate, 6 lawyers, UK. Junior title → SMB → webinar CTA. No title in opening since 'Senior Associate' = junior tier.
